name: a2ui-renderer
title_zh: 让AI界面在React应用中自动渲染的A2UI引擎
tagline_zh: AI不再只回文字，还能直接生成可交互界面。自动激活，无需手动传消息，一行配置即可让CopilotKit应用拥有原生。
tagline_en: AI outputs become interactive UIs automatically. No manual message passing—just configure once and let CopilotKit.
desc_en: Render A2UI (Agent-to-UI declarative surfaces) in CopilotKit v2. Enable the runtime via CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }), then enable the provider via <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}>. Auto-activates via /info — do NOT manually pass renderActivityMessages. createA2UIMessageRenderer ships from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; low-level primitives (A2UIProvider, A2UIRenderer, createCatalog) ship from @copilot
why_zh: 不同于传统流式文本，它通过/info自动激活渲染管线，从底层A2UIProvider到高层组件全链路打。
why_en: Unlike plain text streaming, it auto-activates via /info, wiring low-level primitives to high-level components—so you get.
